newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bomb blast at Turkish Islamist party, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast at Turkish Islamist party, no injuries.

text.p: A bomb exploded at a local branch of Turkey's ruling Welfare Party on Monday morning but there were no injuries, Anatolian news agency said.
It said the device damaged the Welfare office in the Istanbul district of Kagithane and broke the windows of nearby buildings.
Leftist, Kurdish and Islamist groups have all carried out bombings in the city in the past.
Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan's Welfare rules in coalition with a secularist party headed by Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller.
